title: A second run found no clear article advantage
question: Does the near-zero correct-versus-shuffled text gap persist with a second training seed?
configuration: Training seed 1 on the frozen screened dataset. batch 8; two epochs per stage; stride 10; TF32; no 4-bit; cross-attention; softmax gate; raw TS residual; no learnable last value. Evaluated on the same 2,236 test events with three shuffle draws.
finding: The correct article showed no clear forecasting advantage at any of the three forecast lengths. At 140 bars, the correct article’s estimated improvement in mean squared error was +0.0085% (95% interval -0.0061% to +0.0244%).
limitations: Each interval describes one trained model and three shuffle draws. Training effects can vary across seeds. The release times of retained articles remain unverified. The shuffled article is a diagnostic comparison and can come from later test dates. The article-free controls remove text during prediction. Training a price-only model is a separate comparison.

figure.alt: Paired text-control improvements with date-block intervals across three forecast horizons
